title_en: Seeking Intercession through the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) in His Life and After His Death (Part 2)
description_en: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, program on seeking intercession through the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) in his life and after his death (2)

series_en: Debates in Creed - Selections on the Stations of the Chosen One
